facts.meaning: MECHANICS_GENERATION=8 current declaration; derived settings evaluate this when their declarations execute. This is not an ongoing dynamic observer for later edits.
TIME_SHADING=true boolean declaration; actual rendering/timing consumer and host effects separate.
MAX_PARTY_SIZE=6 integer declaration; each caller allocation/guard may have separate local conditions. No claim all party arrays forcibly have6 members.

OVERWORLD_WEATHER_SETS_BATTLE_TERRAIN=(MECHANICS_GENERATION>=8), so current declaration evaluates true. Existing battle-environment consumers determine applicability; no invented weather/terrain rewrite.
NO_MONEY_LOSS=33 is a Game Switch numeric identifier, not true/false or a declaration that money loss is disabled. CORE pbLoseMoney reads game_switches[33].

Constructor @data=[]; getter returns stored truthy @data[id] only when id<=5000, otherwise false. Newly constructed absent slot33 therefore false. Setter stores raw value for id<=5000, with no local type/lowerbound/boolean normalization. false/nil read false, other truthy values returned as stored. Existing/loaded game state may differ from newly constructed absent state; class definition does not force saved33 off.

common_premise: FixedR default source load without plugins or redefinition; ordinary numeric IDs/legal standard objects and prior calls normal. SOURCE_STATIC; producer fields only, not every caller/system/partner or native execution.
